fields.Name: Skip ICF - KPI Gauge Dashboard with Deep Drill
fields.Description: Six radial gauges over real ICF KPIs with trend, breakdown and record drill levels. Ported from "KPI Gauge Dashboard with 4-Level Drill-Down" with KPIs remapped to data that exists.

InputDefinition.userMessage: Design a KPI dashboard with six radial gauges in a 2x3 grid: (1) Conference attendance rate (attended / registered, excluding cancellations) target 85%, (2) Course completion rate target 75%, (3) Conference NPS target 40, (4) Average confirmed revenue per member in 2025 target $400, (5) Committee meeting attendance rate target 80%, (6) Issue resolution rate (resolved or closed / all issues) target 85%. Colour each gauge green if at or above target, yellow if within 10% of target, red otherwise, and show the value and target on each. Clicking a gauge shows that KPI's trend by year; clicking a year shows a breakdown chart of the contributing factors; clicking a segment of that breakdown shows a table of the underlying records with rows that open the record. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes six radial gauges in a grid with value and target labels
All six KPIs are computed from real data in the Orders, Learning, Forms, Committees and Issues entities
Values are plausible for the data (e.g. conference attendance rate about 80%, course completion about 72%, committee attendance about 73%, issue resolution about 80%)
Gauges are colour-coded green/yellow/red relative to targets
Clicking a gauge shows a yearly trend chart
Clicking a year shows a breakdown chart; clicking a segment shows a table of records
Final rows can open the underlying records
